articles.title: Judge Newman’s Name may soon be on the Bench, Even if she is Barred from Entry
articles.content:
加州共和党众议员达雷尔·伊萨于2026年8月3日提出H.R.10026法案，该法案旨在将位于717麦迪逊广场西北的霍华德·T·马基国家法院大楼的201法庭命名为“宝琳·纽曼法庭”。201法庭是联邦巡回法院的主要法庭，该法院在这里听取辩论案件并进行全体法官庭审。这项名为《2026年纪念巡回法官宝琳·纽曼法》的法案列出了一系列调查结果，并将法庭命名为唯一的操作部分。

纽曼法官自2023年3月以来未在201法庭就座。最近，最高法院拒绝了《纽曼诉穆尔》案（编号25-1101）的证书请求（2026年6月15日），结束了她三年来试图让第三条法院审查其宪法挑战的合理性的努力。国会制定了允许其停职的法律，而这项法案仅涉及一块名牌。
articles.summary:
by Dennis Crouch

Representative Darrell Issa (R-CA) introduced H.R. 10026 on August 3, 2026, a bill that would designate Courtroom 201 of the Howard T. Markey National Courts Building at 717 Madison Place NW as the "Pauline Newman Courtroom." Room 201 is the Federal Circuit's main courtroom, where the court hears its argued cases and sits en banc. The bill, titled the Honoring Circuit Judge Pauline Newman Act of 2026, lists a set of findings and the only operative part designated the courtroom name.

Judge Newman has not sat in Room 201 since March 2023. Most recently, the Supreme Court denied certiorari in Newman v. Moore, No. 25-1101 (U.S. June 15, 2026), ending her three-year effort to get some Article III court to reach the merits of her constitutional challenge. Congress wrote the statute that allowed for her suspension, this bill though is only about a nameplate.
